description: Explicit reconciliation across the three research populations

PROJECT_3E.description: Full P90-armed NQ population at 5-second checkpoints
PROJECT_3E.sampling_method: Complete census of all causal 5s checkpoints after P90 arming

PROJECT_3F.description: Matched-event retrospective comparison population at 1-second resolution
PROJECT_3F.timeframe: 1-second native bars in micro-windows (T-15s to T+10s)
PROJECT_3F.sampling_method: Retrospective balanced sampling: 10,618 T0 starts of >=30s winning runs matched 1-to-1 with 10,618 continuation pauses selected using future regime MFE extension (rem_max_mfe >= 0.50 ATR)

PROJECT_3F_V.description: Natural causal 1-second streaming population across all P90-armed regimes
PROJECT_3F_V.timeframe: 1-second native streaming bars from P90 arming to regime termination
PROJECT_3F_V.sampling_method: Complete causal streaming: no T0 knowledge, no matched pairs, no future lookahead

why_population_counts_differ:
1. Project 3E evaluated 586,897 discrete 5-second checkpoints across all 6,559 P90-armed regimes.
2. Project 3F selected only 10,618 points labeled T0 (start of a >=30s winning run) and paired them with 10,618 retrospectively filtered false continuation pauses, discarding all other 576,000+ checkpoints and 1,062 non-qualifying regimes.
3. Project 3F-V restores the entire continuous timeline: evaluating every single native 1-second bar (~2.3 million bars) from the exact second P90 becomes armed until regime termination, with zero retrospective filtering.
